hooks.command: FILE="$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' <<< "$CLAUDE_HOOK_INPUT")"; [ -n "$FILE" ] && [ -f "$(dirname "$FILE")/package.json" -o -f "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/package.json" ] && command -v prettier >/dev/null && prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true

FILE="$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' <<< "$CLAUDE_HOOK_INPUT")"; [ -n "$FILE" ] && [ -f "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/pyproject.toml" ] && command -v ruff >/dev/null && ruff format "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true

INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' <<< "$INPUT"); OUT=$(jq -r '.tool_response.stdout // empty' <<< "$INPUT"); MP3="$HOME/.local/share/musictags/straighttoprod.mp3"; echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '(^|[^a-zA-Z0-9_-])gh +pr +create([^a-zA-Z0-9_-]|$)' && echo "$OUT" | grep -qE 'https?://github\.com/[^[:space:]]+/pull/[0-9]+' && [ -f "$MP3" ] && (nohup afplay "$MP3" >/dev/null 2>&1 &) ; exit 0
